rules: All are preliminary casting alternatives; none selected or accepted.
Eligible shot IDs are broad scene-level candidate pools, not selected starting frames.
Provider screening is attributed opinion, not a human verdict or objective ethnicity finding.
John has ten physical candidates and thirty performance portraits; young John is a separate unpaired pool.
Full-lane screening return rows are evidence only and do not count as received images.
